summary: This clinical trial studies the effects of adding dapagliflozin to metformin in male patients who have type 2 diabetes and a liver condition called metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease. The study compares a group taking metformin alone with a group taking both metformin and dapagliflozin for 12 weeks. Researchers will measure changes in protein levels and non-invasive indicators of liver health over the course of three months. The study status is Not yet recruiting and aims to enroll 84 participants.
